enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping. Occasionally shift legs. Turn head. Remain asleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Remove pajamas. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Rub body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo to hair. Rub scalp. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste to toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl, plate, and frying pan. Close cabinet. Turn on induction cooker. Place frying pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs with fork. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs with spatula. Turn off induction cooker. Turn on toaster. Place bread in toaster. Toast bread. Remove bread from toaster. Place eggs on plate. Place toast on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Pick up toast. Eat toast. Drink milk. Finish meal. Stand up. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and glass. Open dishwasher. Place dishes in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to bedroom. Open closet door. Select shirt and pants. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Close closet door. Pick up phone from nightstand. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send reply. Open email app. Read emails. Close email app. Put down phone on nightstand. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Drinking tea and reviewing the day's work schedule on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up mug of tea from coffee table. Sip tea. Put down mug. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Scroll through schedule. Read appointments. Swipe to next day. Read. Put down phone. Pick up mug. Sip tea. Put down mug. Pick up phone. Open notes app. Type notes. Put down phone. Pick up mug. Sip tea. Put down mug. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on computer, desk lamp on, drafting program plans and emails
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Press computer power button. Wait for computer to start. Enter password. Open email client. Read first email. Click reply. Type response. Click send. Open second email. Read. Click reply. Type response. Click send. Open word processor. Create new document. Type heading. Type paragraph. Type bullet points. Save document. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Save spreadsheet. Open browser. Search for information. Read article. Close browser. Open email client. Check for new emails. Read new email. Click reply. Type response. Click send. Stretch arms. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Return to desk. Sit down. Continue typing. Save document. Turn off desk lamp. Close computer. Stand up. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out plate and knife. Close cabinet. Pick up knife. Cut lettuce. Cut tomatoes. Cut cheese. Place lettuce on plate. Place tomatoes on plate. Place cheese on plate. Open drawer. Take out fork. Close drawer. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat salad. Drink water from glass. Finish meal. Stand up. Pick up plate and fork. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and fork. Open dishwasher. Place dishes in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe counter. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Short walk around the neighborhood after lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Close front door. Walk down driveway. Turn left on sidewalk. Walk straight. Look at trees. Continue walking. Turn right at corner. Walk past houses. Cross street. Walk around block. Turn left. Walk back to house. Walk up driveway. Open front door. Enter house. Close front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on computer, attending video calls with community partners
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Press computer power button. Enter password. Open video conferencing app. Join meeting. Adjust camera angle. Unmute microphone. Greet participants. Listen to speaker. Take notes on paper. Mute microphone. Type in chat. Unmute microphone. Speak. Share screen. Show document. Stop sharing. Listen. Mute microphone. Take notes. Unmute microphone. Ask question. Listen to response. Mute microphone. Leave meeting. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open document. Type. Save. Turn off desk lamp. Close computer. Stand up. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the couch and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote control. Press power button to turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse news app. Scroll. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken, vegetables, and sauce. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board, knife, and pan. Close cabinet. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Cut chicken. Cut vegetables. Add chicken to pan. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Turn on range hood. Turn off range hood. Place food on plate. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to kitchen. Sit at table. Pick up fork and knife. Cut food. Eat. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Pick up plate and utensils. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and utensils. Open dishwasher. Place dishes in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk out of house. Close front door. Walk down driveway. Turn left on sidewalk. Walk straight. Look at streetlights. Continue walking. Turn right at corner. Walk around block. Cross street. Walk past park. Turn left. Walk back to house. Walk up driveway. Open front door. Enter house. Close front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for the night
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Rub scalp. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wipe face. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and browsing on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Scroll. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Open game. Play game. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Return with glass of water. Sit on couch. Drink water. Put down glass. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check email. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and reading on phone with fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open reading app. Select book. Read. Scroll page. Read. Adjust fan speed. Read. Put down phone. Turn off fan. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping. Occasionally shift legs. Turn head. Remain asleep.
